absent_coverage: Only two PVT points (and their listed solver/rate neighbours) are simulated; this is a focused diagnosis, not a re-run of the 360-point campaign, and it does not re-grade any other point.
The orthogonal ll/hh passive-skew axis and mismatch Monte Carlo are not exercised.
No ratified ramp envelope exists (DR-003 Sec8); adjacent rates are a factor of 2 either side of each target and are exploratory controls only.

Solver variants change integration settings only; none changes the circuit, and none removes the temp_core startup nonphysical-branch behaviour of #86 by construction, so a 'no physical-branch run exists' outcome is possible and is reported as unresolved.
author: Loom Builder (claude-sonnet-5-5)
claim: Issue #142 -- NOT a spec claim and NOT a ratified ramp envelope (DR-003 Sec8). Diagnoses the two RESETn re-assertions recorded in 20261010-015905-fbd6329 (as-drawn, 360 points) by re-running exactly those two PVT/rate points on the unchanged assembled temp_por_top netlist with solver discriminators and adjacent-rate controls, as single-corner klt sim requests on the Spot batch fleet, graded from full-resolution waveforms with extra internal nodes saved for event ordering. A per-point verdict (solver/nonphysical artifact | physical design-level re-assertion | unresolved) is assigned mechanically by run_reassert_diagnosis.py under the issue's evidence rules.
post_hoc_note: The first batch (18 cases: base, trtol7, reltol2e-4, trap, tmax1u at the exact rate; base and trtol7 at the adjacent rates) was submitted at 124894f. After inspecting it the matrix was extended with reltol1e-4, reltol2e-4-tmax1u (exact rate) and reltol2e-4 (adjacent rates), submitted as a second batch into the same run directory. The extension was chosen to obtain more physical-branch runs, not to change the verdict rules, which were fixed before any result.

base.description: Same solver settings as the source campaign (testbench `.options method=gear trtol=50`, tmax 5 us); only extra .save cards for internal nodes are added. Reproduction control for the original case.

reltol1e-4.description: ADDED AFTER the first 18-case batch was inspected (that batch gave only one physical, resolved exact-rate run for point A, too few to judge physical-branch stability): trailing `.options method=gear trtol=50 reltol=1e-4`.

reltol2e-4.description: Trailing `.options method=gear trtol=50 reltol=2e-4` (tighter relative tolerance; the #86 discriminator of the same name). Also used as an adjacent-rate control (variant use ADDED AFTER the first batch, so that adjacent-rate controls include a physical-branch candidate).

reltol2e-4-tmax1u.description: ADDED AFTER the first batch (same reason): `reltol2e-4` options combined with maximum time step 1 us.

tmax1u.description: Same options as base but maximum time step 1 us (5x finer than the source campaign).

trap.description: Trailing `.options method=trap trtol=7` (trapezoidal integration instead of gear).

trtol7.description: Trailing `.options method=gear trtol=7` (tighter local-truncation-error acceptance; the #86 discriminator of the same name).
